repos_data.description: Tentra MCP — memory for AI coding agents. Persistent code graph + AI architecture diagrams. 32 MCP tools. Works in Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Windsurf.
Read-only MCP server for official Python docs: local index, no API keys, exact symbol lookup, version-aware retrieval.
Hosted MCP server for structured public web data — 1118 tools across search, maps, commerce, social & finance, returning clean JSON.
C/C++ semantic index for AI coding assistants — powered by your compile_commands.json. Query the program your compiler actually builds, not just the source files.
Embedded MCP toolkit for AgentLux marketplace, identity, creator, services, and social flows
RAG MCP Registry Finder (RAGMap): subregistry API + MCP server + Firestore ingestion
MCP server for codewiki.google — search, fetch docs, and ask questions about any open-source repo
MCP server for AI agents: optimize & convert images (WebP/AVIF/JPEG), QR codes, cited storage data and 18 dev utilities. Zero-auth.
A MCP server for using Semgrep to scan code for security vulnerabilities.

Condition-aware ingredient & product safety MCP server — 9 tools, every answer with a verdict, evidence tier, and citations. com.healthai/clarity on the official MCP registry. Hosted at mcp.healthai.com.
Grounder MCP - live web search, fetch, deep_search evidence packs, and agentic research for local & cloud LLMs. Thin client for grounder.dev.

repo_meta_data.description: The open-source MCP server behind ByteAsk Embedded Docs: a source-grounded, page-cited evidence-retrieval server for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) that write firmware / driver / protocol code and need exact facts.
